Discovery cohort comprises20individuals19unique alleles, including three with limitedclinicaldetail; only17have detailedphenotyping (14NDD/3CMT). It is not20equally established causal diagnoses. Main statement14denovo plus remaining5 is not a transparent20person partition; Table1is uniqueallele-oriented with recurrent3/12.

Appendicular HYPERtonia sourceTableS2 has been replaced by HYPOtonia in allfive mappedpackets. Individual1positive changes direction; fournegativehypertonia statements do not establish hypotoniaabsence.

Supplementnotes: BAB4646 has two TRNT1 variants c.1246A>G Lys416Glu and c.608+1G>T with unestablishedphase; they plausibly explain DD/immunodeficiency. M42-1 has an affected sibling and mitochondrialencephalopathy/stroke-likeepisodes not fullyexplained by DHX9pLoF. These cases should not be promoted to exclusive DHX9 causal truth.

Figure4HPO clustering is within-discovery-cohort analysis, not independentcasevalidation; Methods specify Lin/symmetricLin while caption specifies Resnik. Four clusters are chosen by silhouette slope; annotationdepth differs markedly acrossclusters. These source-paper analyses were read; no compact-cohort inference ranks/results were opened.

G411E reduces protein-normalizedATPase; R761Q increases normalizedactivity but lowers proteinabundance. RawTableS3R761Q0.602/WT0.651 cannot by itself be called totalgainoffunction. V473I/C608G nearWT ATPase does not rule out otherfunctionaldefects. S9caption points toS2rawdata but actualATPase table isS3.

NLSR1166P/K1163R cytoplasmicmislocalization, R141QDNA/R-loopdamage and threeCMTvariant nucleolarredistribution support heterogeneous mechanisms. Individual6K1163Rfibroblasts versusfather give patient-derived evidence for that variant only. TransfectedcDNA truncationassays do not measure endogenousNMD. AlphaFoldlow-confidence disorderedresidues and c.627-4dupA splice predictions do not substitute for measured structure/RNA.

MousehomozygousDhx9knockout viable withbehavioral,hearing,grip,weight and systemicphenotypes differs from earlier embryonic-lethal allele; construct/backgroundexplanations remainhypotheses. Mousemodel not equivalent to humanheterozygousalleles or drugrescue. MouseexperimentTableS1samplecounts vary byassay; no multiple-comparison correction was used.
